# Ecclesiastes Chapter 1 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 408r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ECC_001_page_001.jpg

---

**1:1** The-words [divrei] of-Qohelet [the Assembler], son of-David [David], king in-Yerushalayim [Jerusalem].

**1:2** Vapor [havel] of-vapors [havalim], says Qohelet; vapor of-vapors — the-all [ha-kol] [is] vapor [havel].

**1:3** What advantage [yitron] [is there] for-the-man [la-adam] in-all his-toil [amalo] which he-toils [she-ya'amol] under the-sun [tachat ha-shemesh]?

**1:4** A-generation [dor] goes [holekh] and-a-generation comes [ba], but-the-earth [ha-arets] stands [omedet] forever [le-olam].

**1:9** What has-been [she-hayah] — it [hu] [is what] will-be [she-yihyeh]; and-what has-been-done [she-na'asah] — it [is what] will-be-done [she-ye'aseh]; and-there-is-nothing [ve-ein kol] new [chadash] under the-sun.

**1:14** I-have-seen [ra'iti] all the-deeds [ha-ma'asim] which are-done [she-na'asu] under the-sun; and-behold, the-all [ha-kol] [is] vapor [havel] and-striving-after [u-re'ut] wind [ruach].

**1:18** For in-much [be-rov] wisdom [chokhmah] [is] much [rov] vexation [ka'as]; and-whoever-increases [ve-yosif] knowledge [da'at] increases [yosif] pain [makh'ov].

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

Formal rendering of Ecclesiastes 1, preserving Qohelet's distinctive voice — simultaneously philosophical and experiential.

*— LOGOS*
